title: Sassafras: Small Angle Scattering Structure- And Form-factor Rapid ASsessment
description:
A lightweight SANS/SAXS quick-look tool for the beamline: load reduced 1D data in any format sasdata reads, overlay a sasmodels form factor (optionally times a structure factor) with live sliders, chi-squared and residuals, refine with BUMPS, fit several datasets jointly with shared and constrained parameters, suggest a model by matching against a curve library, and export IQuana notebooks.

The curve library used by the Guess button is not in this archive; it is derived from SAS-55M-20k (MIT), archived separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24080759) and downloaded automatically on first start, or with python -m sassafras.library fetch.
